dict_1.title: What is a Dictionary?
dict_1.prompt: In Python, a dictionary stores information using...
dict_1.explanation: Dictionaries are like address books! 📒 Every piece of information has a name (key) and a value. For example: {"nome": "Ana", "idade": 12}

dict_2.title: Dictionary Keys
dict_2.prompt: In a dictionary, we use curly braces { } instead of brackets [ ].
dict_2.explanation: That's it! Lists use [ ], but dictionaries use { }! It's easy to remember: dictionaries need keys 🔑 to open!

dict_3.title: Accessing Values
dict_3.prompt: Complete the code to show the person's name:
dict_3.explanation: To get a value from the dictionary, use the key inside brackets: pessoa["nome"] gives "Lucas"! 🔑

dict_4.title: Adding to the Dictionary
dict_4.prompt: How do we add a new key "cidade" with the value "Rio"?
dict_4.explanation: It's simple! Just do pessoa["cidade"] = "Rio" and you're done! The new key is created automatically. ✨

dict_5.title: Creating a Dictionary
dict_5.prompt: Create a dictionary called "pet" with nome "Rex" and tipo "cachorro":
dict_5.explanation: Dictionaries use "key": value. The key is in quotes, followed by a colon, then the value! 📕

dict_6.title: Searching for Information
dict_6.prompt: Create a function that takes a person dictionary and returns their age:
dict_6.explanation: Use pessoa["idade"] to get the age from the dictionary and return to give it back! 🎂

dict_parsons_1.title: Student Record
dict_parsons_1.prompt: Organize the code to create a student record and show the name:
dict_parsons_1.explanation: First we create the dictionary, then we access it using the key!

dict_7.title: Updating a Value
dict_7.prompt: The score changed! Change the value of "pontos" to 50:
dict_7.explanation: To change a value, just use the key and the equals sign! It's like erasing what was written in the address book and writing the new value. ✏️

dict_8.title: Lost Key
dict_8.prompt: What happens if we try to access a key that does NOT exist in the dictionary?
dict_8.explanation: If the key doesn't exist, Python can't find it and yells: KeyError! It's like looking for a name in the address book that isn't there. 📢

dict_9.title: Keys and Values
dict_9.explanation: "cor" is the KEY (name of the information) and "azul" is the VALUE (the actual info). The key opens the value! 🔑

dict_10.title: Is it in the Backpack?
dict_10.prompt: How do we check if the key "mapa" exists in the backpack?
dict_10.explanation: We use `in` to ask if a key exists in the dictionary! It's like looking inside the backpack to see if the map is there. 🎒

dict_11.title: New Price
dict_11.prompt: The potion got more expensive! Change the price to 20:
dict_11.explanation: Dictionaries are easy to update! Just use the key ["poção"] and give it the new value. The old value disappears and the new one takes over! 💰

dict_12.title: Dictionary Size
dict_12.prompt: If we have `d = {"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}`, what does `len(d)` return?
dict_12.explanation: `len()` counts how many keys (pairs) exist in the dictionary. We have "a", "b" and "c", so that's 3 items! 📏

dict_13.title: Deleting Keys
dict_13.prompt: Use `del` to delete the key "idade" from the dictionary:
dict_13.explanation: `del` stands for "delete". It removes the key and the value from the dictionary forever! 🗑️

dict_14.title: Only the Keys
dict_14.prompt: Which method do we use to see all the keys (names) in the dictionary?
dict_14.explanation: `keys()` returns a list with just the keys! It's useful to know what information we have stored. 🔑

dict_15.title: Only the Values
dict_15.prompt: Which method do we use to see all the stored values?
dict_15.explanation: `values()` shows only the values, ignoring the key names. 💎

dict_16.title: Starting from Scratch
dict_16.explanation: To create an empty dictionary, we use curly braces with nothing inside `{}`. Then we can add things! 🎒

dict_17.title: Mixing it Up
dict_17.prompt: Can a dictionary have text keys and number values at the same time? Ex: `{"nome": "Ana", "idade": 10}`
dict_17.explanation: Yes! That's the best part of dictionaries. You can store texts, numbers, and even lists in the same place! 🥗

dict_18.title: Dictionary inside a Dictionary
dict_18.prompt: Access the math score ("mat") of the student "joao":
dict_18.explanation: We can have dictionaries inside dictionaries! First we open the key "joao", then the key "mat". 📦📦

dict_19.title: Looping a Dictionary
dict_19.prompt: When we do `for x in dicionario:`, what is `x`?
dict_19.explanation: By default, the loop iterates over the keys! If you want the values, you need to use `.values()`. 🗝️

boss_battle_10.title: The Librarian of Secrets
boss_battle_10.prompt: Create a dictionary "heroi" with name "Link" and life 100. Then show the hero's name!
boss_battle_10.explanation: The Librarian stores secrets in dictionaries! Use keys and values! 📚
